primary_question: Which state/local-evaluation calibration intervention reduces frozen PF-QPE budgets at decision-relevant times without numerical safety failure?
setting: classical offline calibration; quantum QPE input state held fixed

C1.coordinate_policy: original five positive CISD calibration times plus original S0 exact selected positive time; binary64 source values, no rescaling
C1.safety: epsilon_E-abs(delta_direct)-beta*K/(t*B)>=0; numerical model evaluation, not a general certificate
C1.primary_gain: valid M11, safe M11, B11 <= (1-eta_saving)*B0 per condition
C1.local_gain: valid M01, safe M01, B01 <= (1-eta_saving)*B0 per condition
C1.state_increment: safe M01 and safe M11 and B11 <= (1-eta_saving)*B01 per condition
C1.safety_repair: unsafe M01 and safe M11; separate from gain
C1.counts_exclusions: H-exponential internal matvecs/group preprocessing/norm estimation/backend work require separate complete ledgers
